brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: 4-cell cluster (piece:-1,0,0;half-n + piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full) with 3 top covers forming deck (cover:0,0,0;full;top, cover:0,1,0;full;top, cover:1,0,0;full;top) and drawer:0#-1,0#cut on half-n cut face; staged with laptop-closed on deck and pen inside drawer, visible in top view.

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at junction of the three full bases (0,0, 0,1, 1,0) converted to variant mount and fitted with setSpikeAccessory platform-sm (small platform).

finish.summary: Built L-shaped 4-base desk (3 full + 1 half-n) with capped faces and lockJoints, topped with three full covers as desk surface and a drawer on the half base. Added mount spike at the central triple junction with small platform trapped on it, as requested.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your compact desk unit is on its way — I'll set up a base cluster with a drawer and corner spike.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base (variant half-n, half-s, half-e or half-w) first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
